title: An API Worth Paying For
description: Design REST endpoints with the request/response shape, versioning, and error contract a paying integrator can rely on — using a solo-built invoice-extraction API as the running example.

title: Taking Real Payment
description: Add payment processing to invoicelens the way it actually has to work — a hosted checkout, a webhook that's the real source of truth, and failure handling that doesn't lose the customer.

title: Analytics Worth Looking At
description: Instrument invoicelens to answer real product questions — who's using it, where they drop off, what they'd pay for — without drowning in vanity metrics.

title: Staying Up When It Works
description: Keep invoicelens responsive and affordable as usage grows, using rate limiting, caching, and cost monitoring instead of finding out about a runaway bill after it's a crisis.

title: Charging for What Got Used
description: Design and build invoicelens's metered billing — counting usage accurately, reconciling it with what Stripe actually bills, and communicating a usage-based price so it never feels like a surprise.
